newsitem.title: USA: BEI may have loss from arbitration ruling.
newsitem.headline: BEI may have loss from arbitration ruling.

text.p: BEI Electronics Inc said Tuesday a ruling against it in arbitration with former General Precision Industries Inc shareholders may result in a one-time loss for the company.
BEI said the loss, which it could not quantify, would occur in the quarter in which the shareholders are granted the award.
BEI said the award would be "substantial" if it includes all costs and expenses the former shareholders incurred during arbitration.
BEI and General Precision are involved in a dispute over royalities and other payments relating to BEI's quartz rate sensor technology.
BEI said the arbitration panel weighing the case ruled in favor of General Precision, allowing its shareholders to recover arbitration expenses and costs, including attorneys' fees.
BEI officials were not available for further comment.
